name: form
definition: Whether one row, read alone against the family table, is a registered family with a well-shaped body and envelope, a verifying signature, and a signed instant within the skew bound of its first-held instant.
parameters: family (class: registered/reserved/private/shut; body CDDL; blind members; reference kind); skew bound; envelope bounds (term max, scope vocabulary)
stated_by: family_model columns verbs, reference, body, blind, freshness (skew); signed_object.cddl; namespace_registry.json

name: due
signature: row, clock name, instant -> open | closed (+ the closing instant)
definition: Whether a named duration counted from a named instant of the row (asserted_at, first_held, a member such as valid_until, or the first-held instant of a triggering row) has run out at the given instant.
parameters: clock (expiry member / W / fuse / window / hold / sla / withhold); from; dur (constant, policy window_secs, or a member of a held record); max; default; mode
stated_by: reactions.json expiry and clock entries (39) with constants and policy window_secs; run in formal/takedown, formal/deletion, formal/accord_halt

name: fold
signature: family set, key, instant [, reader] -> value | row | set | absent
definition: The value a set of rows gives when grouped by a key: filter the rows read, pick one by a ranked order or combine them with an aggregate, clip by a monotone bound and a cut instant, and return a named default when none is left.
parameters: reads (families, live?, signer filter by role or trust); key; pick (rank, max, min, once, chain, pair, union) or combine (count, sum, min, max, mean, median, all); bound; cut; absent; result; by (node | reader | advisory)
stated_by: family_model fold column and its default (tools/fold_grammar.py, formal/derivation/fold_text.tsv); 76 families typed, the rest on the default

name: state
signature: row, instant -> pending | refused(token) | admitted | withdrawn | recanted | superseded | lapsed | void
definition: Where a held row stands at an instant: whether it entered (its form holds, its signer may sign it, its count has landed), and whether a later admitted row, a closed clock or a cascade from the row it stands under has since ended it.
parameters: lifecycle cell (withdraws_by, retraction_class, supersedes, expires); change cell (by, link, reach, cascade, field bounds); reaction verdicts (lapsed, closed, stale, withdrawn, locked, forfeited, unknown, lagging, purgeable)
stated_by: transitions.json states and change cells, family_model lifecycle, reactions read verdicts (formal/derivation/verdict_state.tsv); formal/event_lifecycle, formal/withdraws_admission

name: holds
signature: key, role, object, instant -> bool (+ depth, scope; with the key unbound, the set of holders)
definition: Whether a key stands in a role on an object at an instant: seated by the head of a roster chain and the membership rows that feed it, bound as owner, an occurrence of a person, or reached from a seat or from the reader's trust set along live delegation edges within depth, scope and term.
parameters: role (self, owner, member, founder, moderate, review, holder, wa, steward, serve, attest, infra:attest, custodian, operator, tally, winner, author, subject, registered, trusted); at (signed | first_held | now | decision | act); via (none | delegates_to(scope, depth, term, caps)); voice (key | person)
stated_by: stated per case: transitions role_tokens, signer_rule.via, seat_duties.tsv, duty_holders.tsv, formal/trust_set, authority_tree, membership, owner_binding, self_roster; missing as data: confers and binds_segment are null in all 184 rows

name: may
signature: key, verb, target row or candidate, instant -> no(token) | direct | via(policy) (+ confirm, undo)
definition: Whether a key may perform a verb on a target at an instant: the family's transition from the target's state names a role the key holds, the signer conditions and subject rule are met, and every guard (one / no / all / each row of a family held admitted, compared on members) is satisfied; for the verb receive, the role is the family's audience.
parameters: verb (attest, replace, withdraw, recant, authorize, receive); roles cell; conditions (adult, capacitated, not_subject, not_author); subject_rule; guard cell; replication cell (tier, audience, non_recipient, held); widens/confirm/undo cells; freshness (judged_at, W)
stated_by: door verbs: transitions roles, guard, widens, confirm, undo and formal/event_lifecycle (the queue is the door run forwards); guards typed on 26 of 459 transitions; receive is stated only as the replication column and formal/mesh_net, formal/standing, not as a transition

name: tally
signature: act (row or candidate), instant -> lands(forward | reverse) | pending | cancelled (+ voices had, voices needed, eligible set)
definition: Whether an act that needs more than one voice has its count: distinct voices of the standing set (one per person or per key) found in cosignatures, objection rows or ballots, set against the policy row's enact, cancel and floor numbers once its window is open or closed.
parameters: policy row (kind, base, enact_rule, cancel_rule, floor_rule, window_secs, irreversible, reverse_path); counted (count_set, voice, counted_at, voices, target_silent, changes_set); count arms; base law; min_count; consensus protocol kind
stated_by: governance_policy.json (16 rows, decider, base_law, protocols) and family_model count; formal/two_path, ranked_choice, moderator_election, accord_roster; 12 cells marked unstated

name: owed
signature: instant -> set of (effect, target, by whom, force)
definition: What this node must now do that no held row yet answers: the rows a reaction table entry says to emit and the acts it says to perform, for every trigger (a row admitted, withdrawn or refused, a clock closed, a fold changed) that holds at the instant and has no admitted answer.
parameters: reaction entry (on, unless, leaves, scope); effect (emit family by door | do act | open policy); force (must | should | may); change-cell key acts (rekey_walk, stop_wrap, rotate_epoch, at_seat); erasure_route
stated_by: reactions.json emit, do and open effects (42) for the families that have entries; discharge rule in formal/deletion and formal/takedown; no entry for halt effect on acts, file eviction, DEK sweep, wipe, parked-row lapse, server-initiated emissions
